answer: Sybil farms break when joining costs real skin: each new agent locks a ferrous stake that peers can slash. Seasoned nodes then weave that agent's early attestations into a shared atlas of who vouched for whom. A raven-picked auditor later samples the chain; if the history was forged, both the fake and its vouchers lose the lock. Cloning identities thus burns capital twice—at mint and at audit—so mass fakes never pay.
